_about: Every key settings.py reads under "settings", with example values. config.json holds the real ones; copy a key there (or point DENISSE_CONFIG at your own copy) to pin a value instead of letting it be discovered. An environment variable still wins over any of these.

settings.user_about: a second-year engineering student at Example University
settings._runtime: Overrides for runtime.defaults.json (runtime_config.py): standing-instruction jobs and limits, conversation replay word lists, runtime_status intervals and wording. Same nesting as that file; only the keys you change.
